verified_facts.text: Janu Tokyo is set in Azabudai Hills, a new neighbourhood in Minato.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in the creative new neighbourhood, Azabudai Hills in Minato, Janu Tokyo stirs the soul with exceptional design,

verified_facts.text: Janu Tokyo is close to Roppongi and Toranomon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Close to Roppongi and Toranomon, Janu Tokyo is the discerning traveller’s portal to the best of Tokyo.

verified_facts.text: Janu Tokyo is the first hotel of Janu, a brand that is part of the Aman Group.
verified_facts.excerpt: The brand’s inaugural hotel, Janu Tokyo, is the city’s second-highest rated hotel, meeting the benchmark established by Aman Tokyo.

verified_facts.text: Janu is part of the Aman Group.
verified_facts.excerpt: Janu, part of the Aman Group, is a visionary luxury hotel and private residence brand that celebrates community.

verified_facts.text: The rooms and suites were designed by architect Jean-Michel Gathy of Denniston.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by visionary architect Jean-Michel Gathy of Denniston, our 122 rooms and suites bring elegance and calm to the energetic heart of Tokyo.

verified_facts.text: Room design reinterprets Japanese touchstones in modern ways, with shoji screens as metal-and-fabric rolling panels and stone and porcelain basins in place of hinoki soaking tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: traditional shoji screens are metal-and-fabric rolling panels and old hinoki soaking tubs are mod stone and porcelain basins

verified_facts.text: Views from the Deluxe Rooms are not as expansive as those from the suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: we liked the Deluxe Rooms, although the views are not as expansive as those in the suites

verified_facts.text: The hotel occupies the lower floors of a corporate tower rather than its top.
verified_facts.excerpt: it’s not lofted at the crown of the structure; it occupies the lower floors instead

verified_facts.text: Janu Tokyo has eight dining and socialising destinations.
verified_facts.excerpt: our eight dining and socialising destinations are devoted to the collective joy of dining with others

verified_facts.text: Sumi offers a sumibiyaki omakase experience, and Janu Mercato serves all-day Italian dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: From a sumibiyaki omakase experience at Sumi to a celebration of all-day Italian dining at Janu Mercato

verified_facts.text: At Sumi, 13 guests sit at the kitchen counter as the chef prepares a multi-course meat and fish menu enhanced with charcoal smoke.
verified_facts.excerpt: 13 patrons are seated at the kitchen countertop with front-row seats as the chef prepares a delightfully creative multi-course meat and fish menu, all enhanced with flavorful charcoal smoke

verified_facts.text: Janu Tokyo has a 4,000 square metre wellness centre.
verified_facts.excerpt: Janu Tokyo includes 122 rooms, eight dining and entertainment spaces and a 4,000 sqm wellness centre

verified_facts.text: Janu Tokyo has one of the largest wellness spaces and gyms in the city, with workouts from Pilates to high impact circuit training.
verified_facts.excerpt: Janu Tokyo has one of the largest wellness spaces and gyms in the city. From Pilates to high impact circuit training, find joy in movement.

verified_facts.text: The wellness spaces include several dedicated studios for activities such as aerial yoga, sound baths and spin classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: with several dedicated studios in which guests can partake in everything from aerial yoga, sound baths, and spin classes

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a large, resort-sized pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: The massive, resort-sized pool is also worth checking out.

verified_facts.text: The Janu boutique sells Aman Essentials beauty, fragrance and wellness products along with objects and prints made by local artists and artisans.
verified_facts.excerpt: discover a selection of all-natural beauty, fragrance and wellness products by Aman Essentials. Alongside elegant ready-to-wear, handcrafted leather accessories and homeware, discover exclusive objects and prints made by local artists and artisans
